items.text: Among adults booked for elective day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomy, how well do predictors available at booking, including planned list position, predict failed same-day discharge, and how well does the model perform on data from a later period?
items.population: Adults booked for elective day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomy
items.comparator: Not applicable: prediction of risk across patients
items.outcome: Failed same-day discharge (overnight stay after a day-case booking)

finer: Feasible with existing records and 20 analyst days, or with prospective collection if nursing time is found; interesting to the day surgery unit; novel locally; ethical under the data access approval; relevant to the 2028 scheduling cycle.
summary: One prediction question with a validation element.
